en.headline: The Big Picnic returns to Discovery Bay beach after seven years
en.dek: The festival runs 11 a.m. to 10 p.m. on Saturday at Tai Pak Beach with more than 24 live acts, food stalls and a makers market.
body: Discovery Bay’s The Big Picnic music festival returns to Tai Pak Beach this Saturday after a seven-year absence.

Organisers said the event runs from 11 a.m. to 10 p.m. on 21 November, featuring more than 24 live acts across two stages, food vendors, beach bars, a Handmade Hong Kong artisan market and a children’s zone.
General admission tickets are priced at HK$258, with lower rates for youth and domestic helpers. Children under five enter free. The previous edition was held in 2019.
The festival is held at Tai Pak Beach on Lantau Island. Further details are available from the organisers.

zh.headline: The Big Picnic沙灘音樂節時隔七年重返愉景灣
zh.dek: 活動周六上午11時至晚上10時於大白灣沙灘舉行，超過24組現場演出，並設美食攤檔及手作市集。
body: 愉景灣的The Big Picnic音樂節時隔七年，本周六重返大白灣沙灘。
主辦單位表示，活動於11月21日上午11時至晚上10時舉行，兩個舞台將有超過24組現場演出，並設美食攤檔、沙灘酒吧、Handmade Hong Kong手作市集及兒童區。
普通票價為258港元，青少年及家庭傭工有較低票價，五歲以下兒童免費入場。上一次舉辦是2019年。
活動地點為大嶼山愉景灣大白灣沙灘。詳情可向主辦單位查詢。
